xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3022: Work-spawn route ignores the per-issue workModel override — role default wins and then clobbers the record

plan.title: Work-spawn route ignores the per-issue workModel override — role default wins and then clobbers the record
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: `pan start <id> --model X` on an unplanned issue starts planning with auto-start, but the work agent the planning handoff spawns runs on the roles.work default. start-planning validates the workModel body field and drops it; completePlanningAutoSpawn, the deferred retry, the stack-rebuild path and the reactive pickup post no model; and the route's f15697bf6c7 fallback resolveIssueWorkModel always returns undefined since the Cut deleted the per-issue record — and even a non-undefined value would not be forwarded to pan start because the explicitModel gate reads only body.model.
narratives.Proposal: Carry the work model in the planning cycle's auto-start consent record (~/.overdeck/agents/planning-<issue>/auto-spawn-on-finalize.json). start-planning writes it into the new generation; the complete-planning rewrite preserves it; POST /api/agents reads it for consent-bearing requests without a body model, uses it for pre-flight checks and forwards it as --model; spawnAgent, spawnRun and spawnRemoteAgent apply claim.workModel inside withAutoSpawnConsentClaim so every handoff path honors it. Once the consent is spent, the model is no longer readable, so later operator starts use config routing. Delete the dead resolveIssueWorkModel. Update the pan-start skill and PIPELINE-GATES docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Carrying --harness or --effort to the handoff work agent
- Any new per-issue store, .pan/ write, or revival of the deleted pipeline record
- A dashboard UI for choosing the work model at planning start
- Fixing readAutoSpawnOnFinalize in src/cli/commands/plan-finalize.ts (legacy-field reader; CLI messaging only)
- Changing tier resolution semantics (an explicit model skips tiers per PAN-3857)
- Applying the consent work model to operator-initiated starts or to spawns without autoSpawnConsentRequired

autoDecisions.summary: Store the work model in the auto-start consent record rather than .pan/continues/<issue>.xbrief.json
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue comment accepts 'the handoff itself or a durable per-issue home'. The consent record is the handoff's own generation-scoped durable record, exists before planning starts, and every handoff path already claims it; .pan/continues does not exist at start-planning time and would need a write-door commit before any spec exists.

autoDecisions.summary: On a consent-bearing spawn, claim.workModel outranks options.model
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator starts never take the consent-claim path, so options.model there is either the route's forwarded copy of the same value or pan start's prior-agent resume continuity; a stale prior model must not beat the operator's fresh --model on a re-plan.

autoDecisions.summary: The complete-planning consent rewrite preserves workModel; a new planning cycle always sets or clears it
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveAutoSpawnOnFinalize writes a new generation on explicit autoSpawn booleans; without preservation it would silently drop the operator's model, while a fresh planning cycle must not inherit a stale model.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope is the model only; --harness and --effort are not carried
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue title and the 2026-09-26 comment name the model; on the unplanned path those flags configure the planning agent today, and changing that is a separate behavior decision.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete resolveIssueWorkModel instead of re-implementing it
autoDecisions.rationale: It is dead code (always undefined) with a single caller that this plan rewires; keeping a sync per-issue lookup would invite a second, record-like home.

narrative.Action: PRD W1. In src/lib/planning/auto-spawn-consent.ts: add optional workModel to AutoSpawnConsentRecord and AutoSpawnConsentClaim; parseConsentRecord drops a non-string/empty workModel; writeAutoSpawnOnFinalizeFlag(issueId, enabled, options: { workModel?: string | null } = {}) stores a string, clears on null, and preserves the current record's workModel (read under the same lock) when undefined; claimAutoSpawnConsentForWorkStart returns workModel on the claim; add async readAutoSpawnConsentWorkModel(issueId) returning workModel only when status is not 'spent'; withAutoSpawnConsentClaim passes the claim as the operation's second argument. Exact before/after code is in .pan/drafts/PAN-3022.md W1.

narrative.Action: PRD W3. Add exported pure resolveWorkSpawnRequestedModel(bodyModel: unknown, consentWorkModel: string | undefined) to routes/agents/shared.ts (trimmed non-empty string body model wins, else consent model) and update the buildPanStartArgs model doc comment. In spawn.ts (~:459-477): when autoSpawnConsentRequired && !body.model, read readAutoSpawnConsentWorkModel(issueId) via Effect.promise with .catch(() => undefined); requestedModel = resolveWorkSpawnRequestedModel(body.model, consentWorkModel); determineModel({ model: requestedModel, ... }); explicitModel = requestedModel ? spawnModel : null. This widening of the old `(body as any).model ? spawnModel : null` gate is required: it is why f15697bf6c7 never reached pan start. Remove the resolveIssueWorkModel import and replace the stale PAN-3022 comment.

narrative.Action: PRD W4. In src/lib/agents/spawn.ts spawnRun (~:114-118) and spawnAgent (~:606-610), and in src/lib/remote/remote-agents.ts spawnRemoteAgent (~:549-553), change the withAutoSpawnConsentClaim operation to (acceptConsent, claim) => ...({ ...options, model: claim.workModel ?? options.model }, acceptConsent).
